subject.title: feat(anthropic): add claude-haiku-4-5 to claude-cli catalog

question: Should the current-generation Claude CLI picker add `claude-haiku-4-5` as its fast-tier entry, expanding the maintainer-curated default list from four rows to five?
rationale: The patch follows the existing plugin-owned catalog pattern and has real runtime proof, but the merged picker policy intentionally curates default visibility; source evidence does not establish that Haiku is already an approved exception.

options.title: Include Haiku 4.5
options.body: Accept Haiku 4.5 as the current fast-tier Claude CLI entry and review the refreshed branch only for normal merge gates.

options.title: Keep the four-row curation
options.body: Preserve the current curated list and close this additive catalog proposal without changing direct Anthropic support or existing Haiku alias behavior.

recommendation.title: Include Haiku 4.5
recommendation.body: Accept Haiku 4.5 as the current fast-tier Claude CLI entry and review the refreshed branch only for normal merge gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged picker curation was explicitly maintainer-directed and authored by steipete.
